goal: Is ke baad aap loop se sequence print kar sakte hain (even numbers, squares, Fibonacci) aur series bana sakte hain (sum ya product), jaise pehle n numbers ka sum, n factorial, ya 1 + 1/2 + 1/3.
warmup: Apne mobile load ko socho. Har din aap thora sa kharch karte hain, aur aap har din ke baad balance likh sakte hain: woh list ek sequence hai. Ab poore hafte mein jo total kharch hua uska socho: woh ek akela number ek series hai. Ya cricket scoreboard ka socho: har over ke baad ka score ek sequence hai, aur aakhri total ek series hai. Loop dono ke liye bilkul theek hai. Woh ek chhota sa step repeat karta hai, aur loop variable i usay batata hai ke hum kaun se term par hain.
definition: Sequence numbers ki woh list hai jo kisi rule par chalti hai, maslan 2, 4, 6, 8. Series kisi sequence ke terms ka sum (ya product) hai, maslan 2 + 4 + 6 + 8. Sequence banane ke liye loop ke har round mein ek term print karein. Series banane ke liye ek variable (accumulator) mein running total rakhein aur har round mein usmein ek term add karein.
howItWorks: Step 1: rule dhoondhein. Term ko i ke formula ki shakal mein likhein. i-th even number 2 * i hai. i-th square i * i hai. Step 2: formula ko 1 se n tak chalne wale for loop ke andar rakhein. Step 3: agar total chahiye to accumulator ko loop se PEHLE banayein aur loop ke ANDAR update karein. Sum 0 se shuru hota hai (0 add karne se kuch nahi badalta). Factorial jaisa product 1 se shuru hota hai (1 se multiply karne se kuch nahi badalta). Step 4: jawab loop ke BAAD print karein. Do khaas surtein. 1/i jaisi fraction ke liye double aur 1.0 / i chahiye, kyun ke do ints ke saath 1 / i integer division hai aur 0 deta hai. Fibonacci alag hai: har term apne se pehle do terms ka sum hota hai, is liye hum do variables a aur b rakhte hain aur unhein next naam ke temporary variable se aage khiskate hain. Decimals ki tadad control karne ke liye fixed ke saath setprecision (<iomanip> se) use karein.
